title: Female contact activates male-specific interneurons that trigger stereotypic courtship behavior in Drosophila.
quote: the initiation of courtship behavior is significantly correlated with the activation of the transmidline P1 interneurons, the descending P2b interneurons, or both
mapping_basis: synonyms.csv lists P2b as ambiguous between DNxl053 and pIP10; the abstract gives no anatomy beyond 'descending' to choose between them, so UNMAPPED.
stimulation: thermal activation of dTrpA1 (temperature not stated in abstract)
sensory_condition: male placed alone without any courting target
notes: fru-GAL4 MARCM clones expressing dTrpA1; courtship initiation correlated with P1, P2b or both. Abstract does not say what else each clone labelled or describe leg movements; full text (Elsevier) returned HTTP 403 on all routes.
